subjectTypes: single real presenter with visible face and two functional hands
one perspective case or social content card
firstVisualFocus: full-width high-luminance yellow heavy title, then foreshortened presenter-card contact
spatialSkeleton: top single-line promise, left presenter plus diagonal card in middle, bottom before-arrow-after result
readingPath: tilted evidence card and its headline
imageTextRelationship: 人物持卡展示证据；顶端定义主张，卡片提供案例，底部显示结果，三段同一主题
locked: one line near full-width block title
left presenter with near-camera gripping hand and other hand pointing
single large card angled downward right with dark image above white information
adaptive: presenter identity and wardrobe with same gesture
headline and result wording within length limits
actual accent hue and skin/background values while preserving luminance roles

variableContract.person: identity, appearance and clothes may change; left x3-56%, face x13-30%, right hand grips card front and left hand points
variableContract.text: content may change but main title stays 6-8 Hanzi on one line, handwritten cue remains lower left, bottom two compact result groups
variableContract.product: one industry-specific evidence card replaces original card; same card visual mass, dark-photo/white-info structure, tilt and hand contact
variableContract.color: exact hue may change; low-lightness field, one high-luminance accent, white card and result, tiny warm response accent remain

invariantContract.layout: title y3-16%; person x3-56% y17-69%; card x16-92% y28-89% clockwise 16-22 degrees; result y89-99%
invariantContract.visualMass: dark background and black clothing 48-55%, card white 19-25%, card photo 15-20%, bright title 8-12%
invariantContract.specialEffects: near-camera gripping hand 1.3-1.7 face widths, card perspective coherent with internal content, fingers foregrounded over rim, mild localized contact shadow

materialTransformation.action: preserve or reconstruct two-hand presenting pose and isolate human
build one industry-specific case card with synchronized perspective and two content tiers

materialTransformation.trigger: hands do not naturally contact the card
